description: This file defines classes and structures related to WebRTC streaming, including configuration, observer interfaces, and the main Streamer class responsible for managing media streams, displays, cameras, and control panel buttons within a WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: Streamer
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing WebRTC media streams, displays, cameras, and control panel buttons, and handling registration with the operator.

classes.name: StreamerConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for setting up the Streamer, including device IDs, port ranges, and other parameters.

classes.name: OperatorObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing WebSocket connection events with the operator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Streamer instance with specified configuration, recording manager, and connection observer factory.

methods.name: AddDisplay
methods.description: Adds a display sink with specified label, resolution, and touch capability.

methods.name: RemoveDisplay
methods.description: Removes a display sink identified by label.

methods.name: AddTouchpad
methods.description: Adds a touchpad input with specified label and size.

methods.name: SetHardwareSpec
methods.description: Sets a hardware specification key-value pair.

methods.name: AddAudioStream
methods.description: Creates and adds an audio stream with the given label.

methods.name: GetAudioSource
methods.description: Provides access to the mixed audio source originating from the client.

methods.name: AddCamera
methods.description: Adds a camera controller for a specified port and camera ID.

methods.name: AddCustomControlPanelButton
methods.description: Adds a custom button to the control panel with command, title, and icon.

methods.name: AddCustomControlPanelButtonWithShellCommand
methods.description: Adds a control panel button with an associated shell command.

methods.name: AddCustomControlPanelButtonWithDeviceStates
methods.description: Adds a control panel button with specific device states.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers the streamer with the operator using an observer.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the streamer from the operator.
